verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email API/infrastructure product for AI agents, not a team helpdesk or shared-inbox collaboration tool; there is no concept of human teammates, conversation assignment, or routing rules for team ownership in the evidence—only inbox/pod creation, CC/BCC human-in-the-loop, and webhooks for agent workflows. This story targets a team-collaboration/ticketing use case that is a category mismatch for AgentMail's agent-inbox API model.
